main_text.head: DEDICATIO.
main_text.p: maximis beneficiis ornati, istoc pacto debi-tas gratias habere censeantur, & cum di-gnas referre nequeant, quasi perenni monu-mento sese debendi reos profiteri, & me-morem gratumque animum publice sponde-re; Tibi rursum, SERENISSIME PRIN-CEPS, Vobisque, ILLUSTRES PROCE-RES, hafce profectuum meorum primitias deberi manifestum est, quorum immortali beneficio illud confecutus sum, quo mihi nihil neque optatius, neque in omni vita ju-cundius accidere poterat, ut quarum littera-rum summo studio inde à prima adolescen-tia, occulto & singulari quodam naturæ in-stinctu, ducebar, in iisdem porro excolen-dis & docendis, honestis conditionibus, in publica luce, summa cum animi volu-ptate ætatem agere liceat. Sive denique (ut ne Vos prolixo sermone morer, & laudum Vestrarum præconio, cui me prorsus impa-rem esse sentio atque intelligo, aliis relicto, ea saltem, quæ mihi propria maximaque sunt, attingam) sive, inquam, hunc par-tum alicui tollendum offerre debeam, & in cli-

page.notes: The first line of the page is the continuation of a dedication; the word "cli-" at the foot is a catchword-like hyphenated line end, which is printed as the last line and is therefore also given as catchword. Some letters are blurred (e.g. "sum", "illud") but read with reasonable confidence. The small marks in the margins are specks, not text.
